title: IndexGeneration
description: The status of one index generation of a source (master plan 12.3, 14.2 'invalidate/rebuild a generation'). A generation is built per source from one set of component versions (parser, OCR, chunker, embedder); a changed component creates a new generation, which becomes active only after validation, and the previous one is retained until then, so there is never a moment without a serving generation once one existed. Every member is computed by the core, so every member is 'alixai'. The state decides which timestamps exist: a generation that is building, validating or failed was never active; an active generation has an activation time and no retirement; a superseded one has both; an invalidated one has a retirement and is never retrievable. A generation whose embedder is null has no embeddings and serves FTS-only results, which carry the reduced_semantic_recall notice. That embedded_chunks never exceeds chunks is checked by the core.

state.description: Lifecycle. building: being filled. validating: complete and being checked before activation. active: serves queries (at most one per source). superseded: replaced by a newer active generation, retained for rollback until purged. failed: could not be built or did not validate, never served. invalidated: withdrawn by an operator or a detected problem, never retrievable again, kept only until a rebuild replaces it.

components.description: The component versions this generation was built with.

activated_at.description: When the generation became active, or null if it never did.

retired_at.description: When it stopped serving (superseded) or was withdrawn (invalidated), or null while it has not.

error.description: Present when the generation failed, and may be present when it was invalidated: the typed, non-sensitive reason.

ocr.description: The OCR engine, or null when the source's policy runs no OCR.

embedder.description: The embedding model, or null when the profile runs without one (FTS only).

documents.description: Source items (at their indexed versions) in the generation.

embedded_chunks.description: Chunks that also have an embedding. Embeddings are queued work, so this can trail chunks while a generation builds.
